tools.name: make_booklet
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to print a PDF as a booklet (saddle stitch: print double-sided, fold in half, staple), make a zine or program booklet, or put 2 or 4 pages per sheet side for a handout. Takes one attached PDF (up to 200 pages), layout booklet, 2up or 4up, sheet auto, letter, a4, tabloid

tools.name: plan_booklet
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which pages go on which sheet for a booklet or a 2-up or 4-up print, how many sheets a booklet needs, or how many blank pages a booklet gets, without a file. Takes a page count from 1 to 1,000, layout booklet, 2up or 4up, and binding left or right, and returns the sheet c

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "make_booklet" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
